draft.title: Lilith trine North Node
draft.humanMoment: A housing cooperative replaces several private amenity rooms with a large communal kitchen after residents openly ask for a place to cook and eat together.
draft.developmentDetail: The revised floor plan gives the kitchen central space, but the construction budget still leaves staffing and maintenance unresolved.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Lilith brings the once-dismissed appetite for shared meals into the open, while the North Node gives that want a place in the cooperative’s next chapter.
draft.aspectMechanic: The trine lets the demand for a communal kitchen and the revised floor plan reinforce each other with little resistance, helping construction advance or allowing the maintenance gap to travel farther without question.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the kitchen is fully funded and maintained, shared meals become part of how the cooperative operates; if those costs remain absent, the redesign preserves the old limits behind a new image.

judge.weakest: If the kitchen is fully funded and maintained, shared meals become part of how the cooperative operates; if those costs remain absent, the redesign preserves the old limits behind a new image.
judge.why: The phrase "old limits" is slightly abstract, but the sentence still gives a concrete, scene-based contrast between an operating communal kitchen and an unfunded redesign.
